lane_impact: economy + rebirth-elements: config REBIRTH.earlyGold/tenthGold currently feed p.gold (tests/progression.test.ts:183,192), i.e. coins — the wrong purse. The 25/100 numbers and MAX_DAN_RANK=10 are sound and can be promoted, but the currency must be modelled as a separate premium resource or the mapping relabelled. Corroboration that stat 12 is the rebirth currency: the android anti-cheat trips at HGOLD>60 while DAN<9, and android pays 8x5+20 = exactly 60. The same line shows desktop's 25/100 (8x25+100 = 300) could not run against a >60 check — further evidence the two builds' rebirth economies genuinely diverge.
ledger_text: film shows a **flat +25 gold** every rebirth, no 10th-rebirth tier.
text: Rebirth pays HEAVENLY GOLD (stat 12, the PayVault-backed premium currency), not gold/coins (stat 11) — the desktop doRebirth never touches the coin purse at all.
